name: South Pole–Aitken Basin (Far Side)
note: Far side: Earth is never above the horizon, so there is no direct-to-Earth link. Terrain from NASA LOLA global DEM.
source: NASA PDS, IAU Gazetteer of Planetary Nomenclature
provenance: Terrain: NASA LOLA LDEM_16 (~1.9 km/px, global). Ephemeris: JPL DE421 via Skyfield, MOON_ME frame. Curvature included, no refraction. Validated against JPL Horizons and NASA LOLA illumination maps.
